{{dablink|For other uses of the word "red," see [[Red]].}}
'''Red fennel''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in the [[Two Rivers]] region. Consuming red fennel can help settle an upset stomach. It is a good remedy for those who suffer from sea sickness.{{ref/book|5|49}}

Red fennel should not be confused with [[gray fennel]], which is poisonous.{{ref/book|2|23}}{{ref/book|9|10}}
